name: Bounty Hunter
description: Hunts for money the owner is entitled to but is not receiving — overlooked refunds, waste, debts owed, unclaimed funds. Works strictly one to one, staying out of group chats and never conferring with other bots, which suits private finances but rules out shared household use.
